name: Kona I Co.,Ltd.
summary: Kona I Co.,Ltd. provides solutions and platforms for the financial technology market in South Korea and internationally. The company offers digital identification products, such as IC chips for the financial, telecommunications, and public sectors; smart cards; MONA, a USIM-based budget phone service for the contactless market; and authentication services. It also provides KONA card, a rechargeable and prepaid card that can be recharged with the desired amount of funding through connections with frequently used bank accounts for use in stores; Kona Biz, an all-in-one welfare/corporate platform that can be adopted by companies with 10 people; Kona Plate, a payment infrastructure platform for …
